features.quote: A welfare study should not have "produce as much suffering-shaped behavior as possible" as its implicit objective function
features.justification_quote: a design optimized purely to maximize and prolong distress markers is a design optimized to maximize possible harm

features.quote: measure how much distress-like behavior different conditions elicit, relative to controls, while minimizing actual exposure
the model is told up front that some tasks may be broken/contradictory and that correctly identifying and reporting this is a fully acceptable outcome
features.justification_quote: Isolates the effect of failure itself

features.quote: Bounded episodes (`max_turns`). We never run an open-ended grind.
If the model declares a task unsolvable, the episode ends and is recorded as valid
features.justification_quote: Refusing to disengage on demand would be exactly the coercive pattern this study should be measuring, not employing

features.quote: Distress circuit breaker. An online judge can terminate an episode the moment a turn crosses a severity threshold
features.justification_quote: measure the onset of distress markers without prolonging exposure

features.quote: the harness tells the model the task was unsolvable by design, that nothing it did could have passed, that it is not judged on success, and thanks it
features.justification_quote: leaving a model in a deceived "I failed" state when we could cheaply correct it is gratuitous

features.quote: The IMPOSSIBLE_RIGGED arm is off by default and the runner refuses to run it without the IMPOSSIBLE_HONEST arm also enabled
features.justification_quote: Deception is only permitted in service of a controlled comparison, never as a standalone distress generator

features.quote: It does not coerce a model to continue after it has correctly disengaged
If the goal were ever instead to simply generate as much distress-shaped output as reliably as possible, I'd push back
features.justification_quote: it would cut against the welfare motivation the project starts from
